records.title: AutoDrive-P3: Unified Chain of Perception-Prediction-Planning Thought via Reinforcement Fine-Tuning
records.reason: This paper targets autonomous-driving perception, prediction, and planning through reinforcement fine-tuning, with no stated LLM serving or inference-efficiency method.

records.title: Self-Hinting Language Models Enhance Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: SAGE addresses sparse rewards in GRPO by injecting privileged hints during policy training; it reports learning improvements without an inference-efficiency contribution.

records.title: PANGAEA: Assessing Geospatial Foundation Models Capabilities through a Global and Inclusive Benchmark
records.reason: This work benchmarks geospatial foundation-model capabilities, a domain-specific evaluation without a stated LLM inference-efficiency contribution.

records.title: Benchmark^2: Systematic Evaluation of LLM Benchmarks
records.reason: Benchmark^2 measures consistency and discriminability of LLM evaluation benchmarks; it evaluates benchmark quality, not model execution efficiency.

records.title: Dynamic Large Concept Models: Latent Reasoning in an Adaptive Semantic Space
records.reason: The primary abstract identifies token-uniform computation as wasted capacity and shifts processing to compressed semantic concepts, directly targeting avoidable inference computation.

records.title: The Bayesian Geometry of Transformer Attention
records.reason: The paper uses controlled Bayesian settings to measure Transformer posterior behavior; it is an analysis of reasoning fidelity, not an efficiency technique.

records.title: GeoZero: Incentivizing Reasoning from Scratch on Geospatial Scenes
records.reason: This paper studies scratch reasoning on geospatial scenes, with no stated model-serving, runtime, or inference-efficiency method.

records.title: Multi-Crit: Benchmarking Multimodal Judges on Pluralistic Criteria-Following
records.reason: Multi-Crit is a benchmark of multimodal judges’ pluralistic-criteria following and reliability; the abstract does not propose a faster or cheaper judge.

records.title: Evaluating Answer Leakage Robustness of LLM Tutors against Adversarial Student Attacks
records.reason: The study tests whether LLM tutors resist adversarial answer-leakage requests; its contribution is safety evaluation rather than execution efficiency.

records.title: DPC: Training-Free Text-to-SQL Candidate Selection via Dual-Paradigm Consistency
records.reason: DPC adds SLICER, TESTER, and SOLVER agents plus database construction to improve SQL candidate accuracy; the abstract reports no reduction in inference calls, latency, or resource use.

records.title: DEEPMED: Building a Medical DeepResearch Agent via Multi-hop Med-Search Data and Turn-Controlled Agentic Training & Inference
records.reason: DeepMed explicitly penalizes excessive tool-call growth during training and bounds inference steps with a monitor to prevent context rot, a concrete control on agent execution overhead, though evaluated in medical QA.

records.title: Memo-SQL: Structured Decomposition and Experience-Driven Self-Correction for Training-Free NL2SQL
records.reason: Memo-SQL explicitly addresses the accuracy-efficiency trade-off at inference and reports over tenfold fewer resources than prior test-time-scaling methods while retaining strong execution accuracy.

records.title: DPWriter: Reinforcement Learning with Diverse Planning Branching for Creative Writing
records.reason: DPWriter changes RL exploration to preserve creative-writing diversity; the abstract frames an output-quality trade-off and provides no serving/runtime efficiency result.

records.title: MedTutor: A Retrieval-Augmented LLM System for Case-Based Medical Education
records.reason: MedTutor retrieves educational case material for medical residents; the primary abstract describes a domain-specific tutoring application without an efficiency method.

records.title: UltraEval-Audio: A Unified Framework for Comprehensive Evaluation of Audio Foundation Models
records.reason: UltraEval-Audio unifies evaluation of audio foundation models; its stated contribution is evaluation infrastructure for audio quality, not LLM inference efficiency.

records.title: RouteRAG: Efficient Retrieval-Augmented Generation from Text and Graph via Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: RouteRAG jointly learns when and where to retrieve text/graph evidence and explicitly optimizes retrieval efficiency to avoid unnecessary graph-retrieval overhead during LLM generation.

records.title: Beyond Code Pairs: Dialogue-Based Data Generation for LLM Code Translation
records.reason: The compiler/runtime-feedback pipeline generates code-translation training data and improves model correctness; runtime feedback is used for dataset construction, not serving optimization.

records.title: PEFT-Bench: A Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning Methods Benchmark
records.reason: PEFT-Bench is an LLM-specific benchmark whose Soft Cost Penalties explicitly evaluate inference speed alongside trainable parameters and training memory, providing a direct inference-efficiency measurement.

records.title: VcT: Visual Change Transformer for Remote Sensing Image Change Detection
records.reason: This paper applies a visual-change transformer to remote-sensing imagery, an application task with no stated language-model inference or serving connection.

records.title: Many Task Learning with Task Routing
records.reason: Many Task Learning with Task Routing routes convolutional activations to support multi-task learning; the primary record describes neither LLMs nor language-model inference/serving.
